articles.title: Live markets: Bitcoin heads lower late Friday as Warsh takes over at Fed
articles.snippet: Kevin Warsh was sworn in as Fed chairman in a White House ceremony early Friday afternoon.

articles.title: Bitcoin implied volatility drops to 7 month low despite macro risks
articles.snippet: BTC's implied volatility is a picture of calm even as financial headlines warn of macro risks.

articles.title: Coinbase premium hits monthly low as institutional selling pressure mounts
articles.snippet: Uncertainty surrounding the current macro environment “appears to be pushing institutions toward hedging strategies while waiting for greater clarity,” said analyst Darkfost.

articles.title: Accused attackers of Sandbox exec’s wife tried to flee via Uber
articles.snippet: CertiK reported earlier this month that criminal wrench attack teams usually consist of three to five people and are often made up of amateurs, while the masterminds are outside the country.

articles.title: Crypto, Banks, Policy Experts Press Congress to Modernize Bank Secrecy Act
articles.snippet: A House subcommittee hearing exposed a divide over how far to scale back the 1970-era anti-money laundering law as Trump expands its reach.
